title: जाति का विनाश
palette: high contrast lamplight palette, deep black, ink on paper, single light source

scenes.p: Lahore in 1936 seen from a rooftop at dusk, flat roofs and minarets receding into haze, kites in the distance, wide shot

scenes.n: एक सामाजिक सुधार संगठन ने डॉ. आंबेडकर को भाषण देने के लिए आमंत्रित किया। विषय था— जाति व्यवस्था का सुधार।
beats: A modest reform society hall with rows of folding chairs being arranged and a table at the front, volunteers working, faces turned away, single light source
A printed invitation letter with an ornate letterhead lying on a dark desk under one lamp, deep black around it, close shot
A bare speaker's lectern and a single microphone in an empty hall, one hard light, deep shadow, medium shot

scenes.p: A hand writing rapidly in ink across ruled foolscap by lamplight, sheets already covered stacked beside it, words not legible, close shot

scenes.n: लेकिन जब आयोजकों ने भाषण की सामग्री देखी... उन्हें लगा कि यह उनकी अपेक्षा से कहीं अधिक तीखा है।
beats: Three men seated around a table reading the same typed manuscript, heads bent, expressions hidden, harsh overhead light
A typed manuscript page with several lines heavily struck through in ink, a hand hovering above it, hard overhead light, close shot

scenes.n: डॉ. आंबेडकर पीछे नहीं हटे। आखिरकार निमंत्रण वापस ले लिया गया।
beats: A typed letter being folded and slid into an envelope, a hand pressing the flap closed, single hard light source, close shot
An empty chair pushed back from a table where a name card lies face down, one lamp, deep black, medium shot

scenes.n: लेकिन भाषण रुका नहीं। डॉ. आंबेडकर ने उसे प्रकाशित किया। नाम था— Annihilation of Caste. हिंदी में— जाति का विनाश।
beats: A freshly bound book lying closed on a dark table under one lamp, plain cloth cover with no lettering, deep black around it, close shot
A printing press platen closing onto a sheet in a dim workshop, ink and metal, single hard light, medium shot
A stack of printed copies tied with string, the top copy's plain cover raked by one hard light, deep black, close shot

scenes.n: यह सिर्फ एक भाषण नहीं था। यह जाति व्यवस्था की बुनियाद पर एक वैचारिक हमला था।
beats: A printing plate under raking light, the type standing in deep relief, ink catching the edges, extreme close-up
A masonry foundation stone with a fine crack running through it, one hard lamp, everything above lost in black, close shot

scenes.n: डॉ. आंबेडकर का प्रश्न था— अगर समाज को वास्तव में बराबरी पर आधारित बनाना है, तो केवल अस्पृश्यता हटाने की बात क्यों? जाति की पूरी व्यवस्था पर सवाल क्यों नहीं?
beats: A masonry wall examined by lamplight, one hand resting on a low foundation stone, the courses above disappearing into darkness, medium shot
A single hand resting on the lowest stone of a wall while the courses above vanish upward into black, one lamp, close shot
A wooden ladder leaning up into pitch darkness, only its lowest rungs lit by a lamp, deep black, medium shot
A tiered arrangement of stones stacked largest to smallest on dark cloth, hard raking light, overhead shot

scenes.n: उनका तर्क था कि अगर जन्म के आधार पर सामाजिक श्रेणियां बनी रहेंगी, तो केवल ऊपरी स्तर पर सुधार असमानता को पूरी तरह खत्म नहीं कर पाएगा।
beats: A steep flight of stone steps in deep shadow lit by one lamp at the base, the upper steps invisible, nobody on them, wide shot
A row of nested wooden boxes largest to smallest under one hard light on dark cloth, overhead shot
A single figure standing on the lowest of many steps looking up, seen from behind, deep shadow, wide shot

scenes.n: उन्होंने जाति को केवल एक सामाजिक बुराई के रूप में नहीं देखा। उन्होंने उसे सामाजिक संगठन की एक ऐसी प्रणाली के रूप में देखा जो लोगों को जन्म के आधार पर अलग-अलग दर्जों में बांटती है।
beats: Looking straight down at nested wooden boxes arranged largest to smallest on dark cloth, single hard light, overhead shot
A pyramid of stacked bowls of decreasing size on dark cloth, one hard light, deep black, medium shot
A printed diagram of stratified horizontal layers on aged paper under a lamp, close shot
A honeycomb grid of small compartments in shadow, one lamp raking across it, medium shot

scenes.n: और इसी कारण उन्होंने केवल छुआछूत खत्म करने के बजाय जाति के विनाश की बात की।
beats: A chisel and hammer set against the base of a stone block, single light source, dust on the blade, close shot
A cracked stone block splitting along a fault line under one hard light, dust rising, deep black, medium shot

scenes.n: इस पुस्तक ने एक और विवाद को जन्म दिया। महात्मा गांधी ने इसके कुछ तर्कों की आलोचना की। डॉ. आंबेडकर ने जवाब दिया।
beats: Two newspapers lying open on a table beneath one lamp, columns dense and unreadable, deep shadow beyond, overhead shot
Two typed pages pinned side by side on a dark board, dense columns, one lamp, medium shot
A fountain pen paused mid-sentence over a reply letter, ink still wet, hard light, deep black, close shot

scenes.n: यह बहस भारतीय सामाजिक चिंतन के इतिहास में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण बन गई।
beats: A small lecture room at night with two lecterns facing each other and empty chairs between, one lamp burning, wide shot
Two open books facing each other propped on stands under a single lamp, deep black between them, close shot

scenes.n: लेकिन यहां एक बात ध्यान देने लायक है। डॉ. आंबेडकर का संघर्ष केवल हिंदू समाज की आलोचना तक सीमित नहीं था। वह यह भी पूछ रहे थे— भारत में लोकतंत्र कैसे काम करेगा?
beats: A packed public hall seen from behind the last row, every seat taken, a single shaft of light on the platform, wide shot
A shaft of light falling on an empty speaking platform in a dark hall, rows of heads silhouetted, wide shot
A ballot box on a table lit by one lamp with a queue of hands reaching in from the dark, medium shot
A bare wooden noticeboard with one pinned paper notice under a single lamp, deep shadow, close shot

scenes.n: क्योंकि लोकतंत्र केवल वोट डालने का नाम नहीं। अगर समाज में कुछ लोग जन्म से ऊंचे और कुछ जन्म से नीचे माने जाते हैं...
beats: A line of people waiting at a polling table, identical ballot slips in each hand, hard lamplight, all seen from behind, wide shot
Identical ballot slips held in many hands reaching into a pool of hard lamplight, deep black, close shot
One figure standing tall and one stooped, both lit by a single lamp against a black wall, medium shot

scenes.n: तो एक व्यक्ति का वोट बराबर होने के बावजूद उसकी सामाजिक स्थिति बराबर नहीं होती।
beats: Two identical ballot slips lying side by side on a table, one weighted down by a heavy stone, single hard light, close shot
A single ballot slip pinned flat under a heavy stone on a dark table, one hard light, extreme close-up

scenes.n: यही अंतर आगे चलकर उनकी 'social democracy' की अवधारणा में दिखाई देगा।
beats: A brass balance scale on a dark table with one pan held down by an unseen weight, single lamp, deep shadow, close shot
A brass scale tilted hard to one side though both pans hold identical slips, one lamp, deep black, medium shot

scenes.n: और इसीलिए डॉ. आंबेडकर के लिए राजनीतिक स्वतंत्रता अपने आप में अंतिम लक्ष्य नहीं थी। वह पूछ रहे थे— क्या स्वतंत्र भारत सामाजिक रूप से भी स्वतंत्र भारत होगा?
beats: A vast dark landscape before dawn with one distant lamp burning in a doorway, sky beginning to lighten at the edge, extreme wide shot
A closed door with dawn light seeping under it into a black room, close shot
A horizon line just beginning to glow above a dark plain, one distant lamp, extreme wide shot
